title: It’s Time to Run an Audit of All the Cloud Storage Links You’ve Shared
gist: David Nield's how-to urges users to regularly audit active cloud storage share links, since risk grows with link age, and compares tools: OneDrive and Dropbox support link expiry, while iCloud and Google Drive do not, with Google Drive also lacking an easy list of shared items.

themes.theme: Stale share links as security risk

insights.claim: Shared cloud storage links from services like Google Drive, OneDrive and iCloud are well protected by default, but their security risk grows the longer they stay active, through mistaken email forwarding or a contact's hacked email account.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Link hygiene and lifecycle controls are a growing consumer/enterprise security need, favoring vendors that automate expiry and auditing.

insights.claim: Microsoft OneDrive and Dropbox both offer built-in expiration dates for shared links, while Apple iCloud and Google Drive offer no reliable link-expiry feature, forcing users to revoke sharing manually.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Feature gaps in sharing controls are a differentiator in cloud storage security; Apple and Google lag on link lifecycle tools.

insights.claim: Dropbox is one of the more aggressive cloud services at tidying up shared links, prompting app users with reminders to review what they have shared.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: Proactive security nudges are a product strength Dropbox can lean on against bundled Big Tech storage.

insights.claim: Google Drive surprisingly lacks an easy list of everything a user has shared; the closest workaround is the People filter or the 'Anyone with the link' option, which WIRED's David Nield criticizes as less convenient than rivals.
insights.speaker: David Nield
insights.so_what: A usability gap in Google Drive's sharing audit could matter for security-conscious users and enterprise admins.
insights.quote: Google Drive, surprisingly, isn't quite as on top of shared links as other cloud storage services.
